definitions.gloss: to spread all over; to cover entirely
definitions.explanation: To lay or spread something across an entire surface without gaps.

examples.english: I spread gravel all over the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Work to tile the entire floor has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}めた⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese-style room with tatami mats covering the entire floor is calming.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Compound verb from ⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to spread, lay) + ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to pack, fill). The ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ component adds the sense of leaving no gaps.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. The thing being spread takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, and the surface takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦{砂利|じゃり}→砂利：14948_jari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to spread gravel
- ⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to lay tiles
- ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to cover with tatami
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to cover with lawn
- ⟦レンガ→レンガ：19408_renga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to pave with bricks
